cohort: 209 pregnant women with singleton pregnancies at term requiring cervical ripening for induction of labor.
finding: Double balloon Cook catheter and misoprostol were equally efficient (76%) in achieving vaginal delivery, with misoprostol showing the shortest time to delivery, and no significant differences in neonatal outcomes were observed between groups.
mod_finding: Double balloon Cook catheter and misoprostol were equally efficient in achieving vaginal delivery, with misoprostol resulting in the shortest time to delivery.
